title: Ben Lirio
description: A shelf for the things I make. Small interactive toys, mostly.
intro: I like making things, and this is where I keep them. Most of them are small interactive toys: a sorting network, a fluid sim, a game of life or two. Some work. Some barely do. They are all here anyway. If any of it is interesting to you, email me. I would genuinely like to hear about it.
eraNote: Everything below this line was made before AI could make it for me. An AI would do most of these almost instantly now, so they are technically uninteresting at this point. They are still cool artifacts, and they took real effort, so they stay.
